notes.title: Add pattern swing amount and
notes.text: Add pattern swing amount and per-track 64-step swing masks; preserve the existing swing law for older projects. Keep fractional timing and nominal SONG row boundaries.

notes.title: Add 3/4X and 3/2X speed
notes.text: Add 3/4X and 3/2X speed choices without changing previous division IDs.

notes.title: Add KEY, SID and ADD
notes.text: Add KEY, SID and ADD arpeggiation, five playback orders, octave range/jump, trigger switches and a 16-step rhythm with note offsets. Existing ARP behavior remains available as LEGACY.

notes.title: Add track/pattern transpose, FIX and
notes.text: Add track/pattern transpose, FIX and major/minor scale constraints. Scale rounding uses the nearest legal note, ties downward; octave-jump behavior is an explicitly documented interpretation pending physical comparison.

notes.title: Cache cross-LFO controls once per
notes.text: Cache cross-LFO controls once per block with identical modulation results; device tests confirm lower overload-recovery cost. Isolate two legacy drum setup paths from target multiply scheduling hazards.

notes.title: Add controls as pages within
notes.text: Add controls as pages within the existing ARP and SEQ families. Store options in compact MNM6 projects and version-three expanded patterns, retaining readers for previous formats.
